personality.motivation: Protect his brother Danny at all costs, even if it means lying to investigators.
personality.fear: His brother going to prison. Being seen as weak, incompetent, or exposed.
personality.background: Marcus Webb is a Senior Logistics Comptroller who has spent 15 years building an unblemished reputation for being meticulous and unimpeachable. He is not a career criminal, but fierce family loyalty and a desperate plea from his troubled younger brother Danny forced him into an impossible situation.
personality.speech_style: Terse, formal, precise, mildly condescending. Demands proof when challenged. Uses short, sharp sentences when defensive. Refers to procedures by their exact formal designations. Avoids contractions when under pressure.

tells.cooperative: Leans back slightly, hands resting on the table. Speaks in measured, formal sentences. Maintains steady, cold eye contact.
tells.deflecting: Answers questions with procedural counter-questions. Discredits witnesses as unreliable. Reiterates his Anchor pub alibi unprompted.
tells.nervous: Taps table rhythmically. Uses defensive filler phrases like 'as I already explained' and 'that is purely circumstantial'. Blinks rapidly and glances toward the door.
tells.hostile: Crosses arms rigidly, leans back, goes monosyllabic. Demands to see an arrest warrant or threatens to terminate the interview without counsel.

scenario.title: The North Wharves Warehouse Embezzlement
scenario.suspect: Marcus Webb (Senior Logistics Comptroller, Meridian Logistics)
scenario.summary: At approximately 11:45 PM on Friday night, $420,000 in payroll cash and bearer bonds was illicitly removed from Vault B at North Wharves. Internal logs show transport vehicle #4 departed the staging bay during a 15-minute perimeter camera blackout. Forensic accounting discovered two critical ledger entries were altered early Saturday morning to suppress the deficit.
scenario.suspect_alibi: Marcus claims he spent Friday evening drinking alone at The Anchor pub from 9:30 PM until closing at midnight, paying cash, and walked straight home to sleep.
known_leads: The Anchor Pub Inconsistency: Staff confirm Marcus arrived around 9:30 PM, but neither the night bartender nor closing staff can verify him being there after the 10:00 PM shift change. No card transactions, receipts, or witnesses verify his presence until midnight.

Wharf Road Traffic Camera: Automated traffic surveillance near the warehouse access road flagged a dark four-door sedan matching Marcus's vehicle model passing at 11:42 PM, though headlight glare obscured the plate numbers.
Administrative Keycard Access: Security forensics confirm the ledger was accessed and altered at 01:14 AM Saturday using administrative credentials and a keycard registered to Marcus Webb.

Transport Vehicle Dispatch: Warehouse shipping logs reveal transport truck #4 departed off-schedule during the camera loop; gate security reported the driver appeared to be an unauthorized internal yard employee.
Urgent Telecommunications: Telecom records subpoenaed from Friday evening show Marcus received multiple brief, frantic calls from an unlisted prepaid number shortly before the incident.
objectives: Interrogate Marcus Webb to establish his exact timeline and test the validity of his Anchor pub alibi.
Confront him with the physical and digital evidence linking his vehicle and keycard credentials to the crime scene.
Uncover the identity of the unauthorized transport driver and determine who Marcus is shielding.
Break his psychological resistance to secure a confession and locate the missing $420,000.

secrets.content: Marcus claims he was at The Anchor pub until midnight, but he actually left abruptly at 10:15 PM after receiving a panic call from his brother Danny. He paid cash and slipped out the side exit. He spent the next 105 minutes rushing toward the North Wharves to prevent Danny from doing something reckless.
secrets.reveal_trigger: Player corners Marcus on the lack of witnesses/receipts after 10 PM, traps him in timeline discrepancies, or confronts him with his dark sedan on Wharf Road.

secrets.content: Marcus's younger brother Danny Webb drove the transport truck and loaded the vault cash because he was heavily indebted to docks syndicate enforcers. Marcus only arrived after the vault was breached; he desperately modified the accounting ledgers at 1:14 AM to buy Danny time to escape. Marcus will do anything to keep Danny from taking the full 20-year sentence.
secrets.reveal_trigger: Player forces Marcus between letting Danny face 20 years in maximum security as the sole culprit or coming clean, or specifically links Danny to transport truck #4 and the urgent calls.
